patch_description: This replaces recursive Kalman state updates with a causal, robust, multi-scale local-polynomial estimator. At every endpoint it fits weighted quadratic models over both short and long trailing histories, using Tukey/Huber-style robust reweighting to reject spikes. The two estimates are adaptively blended: the short model dominates during genuine high-curvature motion, while the longer model suppresses noise during stable regions. A noise-scaled directional hysteresis stage then rejects tiny opposite-direction movements without delaying meaningful reversals. This directly targets false reversals and slope-change reduction while retaining endpoint alignment and low-lag trend tracking.
